# GitHub

> > The world's leading AI-powered developer platform for building, collaborating, and shipping software with tools like GitHub Copilot, Actions, and Codespaces.

GitHub hosts millions of open source projects and provides integrated DevOps tools including CI/CD pipelines, code security scanning, cloud development environments, and AI-assisted coding. The platform serves individual developers, organizations, and enterprises across all programming languages and frameworks.

## Key Topics

- GitHub Copilot
- GitHub Actions
- GitHub Codespaces
- AI code assistant
- Developer platform
- Collaboration
- CI/CD automation
- Code security
- Cloudflare Workers
- Cloudflare R2
- Image hosting
- MicroPython
- Open source
- Cloud development
- Version control

## Platform Overview

- [GitHub Homepage](https://github.com): AI-powered developer platform homepage featuring Copilot, Actions & more

## Organizations & Communities

- [01.AI](https://github.com/01-ai): AI 2.0 company building LLMs and multi-agent frameworks like Yi
- [01 Education](https://github.com/01-edu): Open learning platform for software engineering and peer education
- [01Studio](https://github.com/01studio-lab): MicroPython embedded programming org with dev boards and IoT projects

## Cloudflare & Serverless Projects

- [JSimages](https://github.com/0-RTT/JSimages): Image/video hosting service built on Cloudflare R2 storage
- [Telegraph Media Hosting](https://github.com/0-RTT/telegraph): Serverless media hosting using Cloudflare Worker and Pages

## Developer Tools & Integrations

- [WHMCS Mollie Payments](https://github.com/0100Dev/WHMCS-Mollie-Payments): WHMCS payment gateway integration for all Mollie payment methods
- [01-Artikelsystem](https://github.com/01-Scripts/01-Artikelsystem): Article and content management module for 01ACP CMS in PHP
- [MapStyleProfile](https://github.com/01100100/mapStyleProfile): Vector map style profiler for MapLibre performance testing

## Documentation & Tutorials

- [01Studio Wiki](https://github.com/01studio-lab/01studio_wiki): 01Studio tutorial wiki built with Docusaurus in Chinese
